G3350.def:
**μετοικεσία**, -ας, ἡ
(= cl. μετολκία, -κησις; μετοικέω, to change one's abode), [in LXX chiefly for גּוֹלָה and cogn. forms, [[Ezk.12.11|Eze.12:11]], Ob 20, al. ;]
**change of abode, migration**: of the Babylonian exile, μ. Βαβυλῶνος, [[Mat.1.11-12, 17|Mat.1:11-12, 17]].†
(AS)

G3326.def:
**μετά** (before vowel μετ᾽; on the neglect of elision in certain cases, V. WH, _App._, 146 b),
_prep._ with genitive, accusative (in poet, also with dative), [in LXX for אַחַד ,עִם ,אֵת, etc.].
I. C. genitive,
1. **among, amid**: [[Mrk.1.13|Mrk.1:13]], [[Luk.22.37|Luk.22:37]] (LXX, ἐν) 24:5, [[Jhn.18.5|Jhn.18:5]], al.; διωγμῶν, [[Mrk.10.30|Mrk.10:30]]
2. **Of association and companionship, with **(in which sense it gradually superseded σύν, than which it is much more frequently in NT; cf. Bl., §42, 3): with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.8.11; 20.20|Mat.8:11 20:20]] [[Mrk.1.29; 3.7|Mrk.1:29 3:7]] [[Luk.5.30|Luk.5:30]], [[Jhn.3.22|Jhn.3:22]], [[Gal.2.1|Gal.2:1]], al. mult.; εἶναι μετά, [[Mat.5.25|Mat.5:25]], [[Mrk.3.14|Mrk.3:14]], al.; metaphorically, of divine help and guidance, [[Jhn.3.2|Jhn.3:2]], [[Act.7.9|Act.7:9]], [[Php.4.9|Php.4:9]], al.; opposite to εἶναι κατά, [[Mat.12.30|Mat.12:30]], [[Luk.11.23|Luk.11:23]]; in Hellenistic usage (but see M, _Pr._, 106, 246f.), πολεμεῖν μετά = cl. π., with dative, **to wage war against** (so LXX for נִלְחַם עִם, [[1Ki.17.33|1Ki.17:33]]), [[Rev.2.16|Rev.2:16]], al.; with genitive of thing(s), χαρᾶς, [[Mat.13.20|Mat.13:20]], [[Mrk.4.16|Mrk.4:16]], al.; ὀργῆς, [[Mrk.3.5|Mrk.3:5]], al.
II. C. accusative,
1. of place, **behind, after**: [[Heb.9.3|Heb.9:3]]
2. Of time, **after**: [[Mat.17.1|Mat.17:1]], [[Mrk.14.1|Mrk.14:1]], [[Luk.1.24|Luk.1:24]], [[Act.1.5|Act.1:5]], [[Gal.1.18|Gal.1:18]], al.; μετὰ τοῦτο, [[Jhn.2.12|Jhn.2:12]], al.; ταῦτα, Mrk.16:[12], [[Luk.5.27|Luk.5:27]], [[Jhn.3.22|Jhn.3:22]], al; with inf. artic. (BL, §71, 5; 72, 3), [[Mat.26.32|Mat.26:32]], [[Mrk.1.14|Mrk.1:14]], al.
III. In composition,
1. **of association or community**: μεταδίδωμι, μετέχω, etc.
2. **Exchange or transference**: μεταλλάσσω, μετοικίζω, etc.
3. **after**: μεταμέλομαι.
(AS)

G3384.def:
**μήτηρ **
genitive,
μητρός, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for אֵם ;]
**mother**: [[Mat.1.18; 2.11|Mat.1:18 2:11]], al.; figuratively, of one who takes the place of a mother, ἰδοὺ, ἡ μ. μου, [[Mat.12.49|Mat.12:49]] (cf. [[Mat.12.50|Mat.12:50]], [[Mrk.3.35|Mrk.3:35]], [[Jhn.19.27|Jhn.19:27]], [[Rom.16.13|Rom.16:13]], [[1Ti.5.2|1Ti.5:2]]); of a city, ἥτις ἐσὶν μ. ἡμῶν, [[Gal.4.26|Gal.4:26]] symbolically of Babylon, ἡ μ. τ. πορνῶν, [[Rev.17.5|Rev.17:5]]
(AS)

G3361.def:
**μή**,
_subjective negative particle_,
used where the negation depends on a condition or hypothesis, expressed or understood, as distinct from οὐ, which denies absolutely. μή is used where one _thinks_ a thing is not, as distinct from an absolute negation. As a general rule, οὐ negatives the indic, μή the other moods, incl, ptcp. [In LXX for אֵין ,אַיִן ,אַל ]
I. As a neg. adv., **not**;
1. with ref. to thought or opinion: [[Jhn.3.18|Jhn.3:18]], [[Tit.1.11|Tit.1:11]], [[2Pe.1.9|2Pe.1:9]].
2. In delib. questions, with subjc. (M, _Pr._, 185): [[Mrk.12.14|Mrk.12:14]], [[Rom.3.8|Rom.3:8]].
3. **In conditional and final sentences, after εἰ, ἐάν, ἄν, ἵνα, ὅπως**: [[Mat.10.14|Mat.10:14]], [[Mrk.6.11; 12.19|Mrk.6:11 12:19]], [[Luk.9.5|Luk.9:5]], [[Jhn.6.50|Jhn.6:50]], [[Rom.11.25|Rom.11:25]], al.
4. C. inf. (see M, _Pr._, 234f., 239, 255),
(a) after verbs of saying, etc.: [[Mat.2.12; 5.34|Mat.2:12 5:34]], [[Mrk.12.18|Mrk.12:18]], [[Act.15.38|Act.15:38]], [[Rom.2.21|Rom.2:21]], al.;
(b) with artic. inf.: after a prep., [[Mat.13.5|Mat.13:5]], [[Mrk.4.5|Mrk.4:5]], [[Act.7.19|Act.7:19]], [[1Co.10.6|1Co.10:6]], al.; without a prep., [[Rom.14.13|Rom.14:13]], [[2Co.2.1, 13|2Co.2:1, 13]] [[1Th.4.6|1Th 4:6]];
(with) **in sentences expressing consequence, after ὥστε**: [[Mat.8.28|Mat.8:28]], [[Mrk.3.20|Mrk.3:20]], [[1Co.1.7|1Co.1:7]], [[2Co.3.7|2Co.3:7]], al.
5. C. ptcp. (see M, _Pr._, 231f., 239), in hypothetical references to persons of a certain character or description: [[Mat.10.28; 12.30|Mat.10:28 12:30]], [[Luk.6.49|Luk.6:49]], [[Jhn.3.18|Jhn.3:18]], [[Rom.4.5|Rom.4:5]], [[1Co.7.38|1Co.7:38]], [[1Jn.3.10|1Jn.3:10]], al.; where the person or thing being definite, the denial is a matter of opinion: [[Jhn.6.64|Jhn.6:64]], [[1Co.1.28; 4.7, 18|1Co.1:28 4:7, 18]], [[2Co.5.21|2Co.5:21]], al.; where the ptcp. has a concessive, causal or conditional force, **if, though, because not**: [[Mat.18.25|Mat.18:25]], [[Luk.2.45|Luk.2:45]], [[Jhn.7.49|Jhn.7:49]], [[Act.9.26|Act.9:26]], [[Rom.2.14; 5.13|Rom.2:14 5:13]], [[2Co.3.14|2Co.3:14]], [[Gal.6.9|Gal.6:9]], [[Jude.5|Ju 5]]; where the ptcp. has a descriptive force (_being such as_), **not**: [[Act.9.9|Act.9:9]], [[Rom.1.28|Rom.1:28]], [[1Co.10.33|1Co.10:33]], [[Gal.4.8|Gal.4:8]], [[Heb.12.27|Heb.12:27]], al.
6. μή prohibitive, in indep. sentences,
(a) with subjc. praes., 1 of person(s) pl.: [[Gal.5.26; 6.9|Gal.5:26 6:9]], [[1Th.5.6|1Th.5:6]], [[1Jn.3.18|1Jn.3:18]];
(b) with imperat. praes., **usually where one is bidden to desist from what has already begun **(cf. M, _Pr._, 122ff.): [[Mat.7.1|Mat.7:1]], [[Mrk.5.36|Mrk.5:36]], [[Luk.6.30|Luk.6:30]], [[Jhn.2.16; 5.45|Jhn.2:16 5:45]], [[Act.10.15|Act.10:15]], [[Rom.11.18|Rom.11:18]], [[Jas.2.1|Jas.2:1]], [[Rev.5.5|Rev.5:5]], al.;
(with) **forbidding that which is still future**: with imperat. aor., 3 of person(s), [[Mat.24.18|Mat.24:18]], [[Mrk.13.15|Mrk.13:15]], [[Luk.17.31|Luk.17:31]], al.; with subjc. aor., 2 of person(s), [[Mat.3.9; 10.26|Mat.3:9 10:26]], [[Mrk.5.7|Mrk.5:7]], [[Luk.6.29|Luk.6:29]], [[Jhn.3.7|Jhn.3:7]], [[Rom.10.6|Rom.10:6]], al.;
(d) with optative, **in wishes**: [[2Ti.4.16|2Ti.4:16]] (LXX); μὴ γένοιτο (see M, _Pr._, 194; Bl., §66, 1), [[Luk.20.16|Luk.20:16]], [[Rom.3.3|Rom.3:3]], al.; μή τις, [[Mrk.13.5|Mrk.13:5]], al.
II. As a conj.,
1. after verbs of fearing, caution, etc., **that, lest, perhaps** (M, _Pr._, 192f.): with subjc. praes., [[Heb.12.15|Heb.12:15]] with subjc. aor., [[Mat.24.4|Mat.24:4]], [[Mrk.13.5|Mrk.13:5]], [[Luk.21.8|Luk.21:8]], [[Act.13.40|Act.13:40]], [[Gal.5.15|Gal.5:15]], al.; ὅρα μή (see M, _Pr._, 124, 178), elliptically, [[Rev.19.10; 22.9|Rev.19:10 22:9]]; with indic, fut. (M, _Pr._, l.with), [[Col.2.8|Col.2:8]]
2. **in order that not**: with subjc. aor., [[Mrk.13.36|Mrk.13:36]], [[2Co.8.20; 12.6|2Co.8:20 12:6]].
III. Interrogative, in hesitant questions (M, _Pr._, 170), or **where a negative answer is expected**: [[Mat.7.9, 10|Mat.7:9, 10]], [[Mrk.2.19|Mrk.2:19]], [[Jhn.3.4|Jhn.3:4]], [[Rom.3.3; 10.18, 19|Rom.3:3 10:18, 19]], [[1Co.1.13|1Co.1:13]], al.; μή τις, [[Luk.22.35|Luk.22:35]], al.; before οὐ ([[Rom.10.17|Rom.10:17]], al. in Pl.), expecting an affirm, ans.; οὐ μή, [[Luk.18.7|Luk.18:7]], [[Jhn.18.11|Jhn.18:11]].
IV. οὐ μή as emphatic negation (cf. M, _Pr._, 188, 190ff.; Bl. §64, 5), **not at all, by no means**: with indic, fut., [[Mat.16.22|Mat.16:22]], [[Jhn.6.35|Jhn.6:35]], [[Heb.10.17|Heb.10:17]], al.; with subjc. aor., [[Mat.24.2|Mat.24:2]], [[Mrk.13.2|Mrk.13:2]], [[Luk.6.37|Luk.6:37]], [[Jhn.13.8|Jhn.13:8]], [[1Co.8.13|1Co.8:13]], al.
(AS)

G3313.def:
**μέρος**, -ους, τό
(μείρομαι), [in LXX chiefly for קָצֶה ;]
1. **a part, share, portion**: [[Jhn.13.8|Jhn.13:8]], [[Act.19.27|Act.19:27]] (Page, in l), [[Rev.20.6; 22.19|Rev.20:6 22:19]]; hence (cl.), lot, destiny, [[Mat.24.51|Mat.24:51]], [[Luk.12.46|Luk.12:46]], [[Rev.21.8|Rev.21:8]].
2. a part as opposite to the whole : [[Luk.11.36|Luk.11:36]], [[Jhn.19.23|Jhn.19:23]], [[Act.5.2; 23.6|Act.5:2 23:6]], [[Eph.4.16|Eph.4:16]], [[Rev.16.19|Rev.16:19]]; with genitive (of the whole), [[Luk.15.12; 24.42|Luk.15:12 24:42]]; τ. Φαρισαίων, [[Act.23.9|Act.23:9]] pl., [[Jhn.21.6|Jhn.21:6]] of the divisions of a province, [[Mat.2.22|Mat.2:22]], [[Act.2.10; 19.1; 20.2|Act.2:10 19:1 20:2]]; of the regions belonging to a city, [[Mat.15.21; 16.13|Mat.15:21 16:13]], [[Mrk.8.10|Mrk.8:10]]; with genitive appos., [[Eph.4.9|Eph.4:9]] in adverbial phrases, ἀνὰ (κατὰ) μέρος, [[1Co.14.27|1Co.14:27]], [[Heb.9.5|Heb.9:5]]; μέρος τι, ἀπὸ μ., in part, [[Rom.11.25; 15.15, 24|Rom.11:25 15:15, 24]], [[1Co.11.18|1Co.11:18]], [[2Co.1.14; 2.5|2Co.1:14 2:5]]; ἐκ μ., [[1Co.12.27; 13.9; 13.12|1Co.12:27 13:9 13:12]]; τὸ ἐκ μ., [[1Co.13.10|1Co.13:10]]
3. A class or category (in cl. usually ἐν μ. τιθέναι, λαβεῖν, etc.) :ἐν μ., in respect of, [[Col.2.16|Col.2:16]] ἐν τ. μ, τούτῳ, in this respect, [[2Co.3.10; 9.3|2Co.3:10 9:3]].†
(AS)

G3341.def:
**μετάνοια**, -οίας, ἡ
(μετανοέω), [in LXX: [[Pro.14.15|Pro.14:15]], [[Wis.11.23; 12.10, 19|Wis.11:23 12:10, 19]], [[Sir.44.16|Sir.44:16]] * ;]
**after-thought, change of mind, repentance**: [[Heb.12.17|Heb.12:17]] of repentance from sin, [[Mat.3.8, 11|Mat.3:8, 11]] [[Luk.3.8; 15.7; 24.47|Luk.3:8 15:7 24:47]], [[Act.26.20|Act.26:20]], [[2Co.7.9-10|2Co.7:9-10]]; βάπτισμα (which see) μετανοίας, [[Mrk.1.4|Mrk.1:4]], [[Luk.3.3|Luk.3:3]], [[Act.13.24; 19.4|Act.13:24 19:4]]; ἡ εἰς θεὸν [[Act.20.21|Act.20:21]] μ. ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων, [[Heb.6.1|Heb.6:1]] εἰς μ. καλεῖν, [[Luk.5.32|Luk.5:32]] id. ἄγειν, [[Rom.2.4|Rom.2:4]] ἀνακαινίζειν, [[Heb.6.6|Heb.6:6]] εἰς μ. χωρῆσαι, [[2Pe.3.9|2Pe.3:9]] μ. δοῦναι, [[Act.5.31; 11.18|Act.5:31 11:18]], [[2Ti.2.25|2Ti.2:25]].†
(AS)

G3303.def:
**μέν**,
_conjunctive particle_ (originally a form of μήν), usually related to a following δέ or other adversative conjunction, and distinguishing the word or clause with which it stands from that which follows.
It is generally untranslatable and is not nearly so frequent in NT as in cl. Like δέ, it never stands first in a clause.
1. **Answered by δέ or some other particle**: μὲν . . . δέ, **indeed . . . but**, [[Mat.3.11|Mat.3:11]], [[Luk.3.16|Luk.3:16]], al.; with pronouns, ὃς μὲν . . . ὃς δέ, **one . . . another**, [[Mat.21.35|Mat.21:35]], al.; pl., [[Php.1.16, 17|Php.1:16, 17]]; ὃ μὲν . . . ὃ δὲ . . . ὃ δέ, some . . . some . . . some, [[Mat.13.8|Mat.13:8]] τοῦτο μὲν . . . τοῦτο δέ, partly . . . partly, [[Heb.10.33|Heb.10:33]] μὲν . . . ἔπειτα, [[Jhn.11.6|Jhn.11:6]] μὲν . . . καί, [[Luk.8.5|Luk.8:5]]
2. **μέν solitarium, answered by no other particle**: πρῶτον μέν (Bl., l.with), [[Rom.1.8; 3.2|Rom.1:8 3:2]], [[1Co.11.18|1Co.11:18]]; μὲν οὖν in narrative, summing up what precedes or introducing something further (Bl., §78, 5), **so then, rather, nay rather**: [[Luk.11.28|Luk.11:28]] (WH, μενοῦν), [[Act.1.6; 9.31|Act.1:6 9:31]], al.; μὲν οὖν γε ([[Php.3.8|Php.3:8]], WH): see: μενοῦνγε.
(AS)

G3309.def:
**μεριμνάω**, -ῶ
(μέριμνα), [in LXX: [[Psa.38.18|Psa.38:18]] (דָּאַג), etc. ;]
1. **to be anxious**: absol., [[Mat.6.27, 31|Mat.6:27, 31]], [[Luk.12.25|Luk.12:25]]; μηδὲν μ., [[Php.4.6|Php.4:6]] with dative of thing(s), [[Mat.6.25|Mat.6:25]], [[Luk.12.22|Luk.12:22]]; before περί, [[Mat.6.28|Mat.6:28]], [[Luk.10.41; 12.26|Luk.10:41 12:26]]; πῶς, [[Mat.10.19|Mat.10:19]], [[Luk.12.11|Luk.12:11]]; εἰς τὴν αὔριον, [[Mat.6.34|Mat.6:34]]
2. **to care for**: with accusative, τὰ τ. κυριου, [[1Co.7.32-34;|1Co.7:32-34]] τὰ τ. κόσμου, [[1Co.7.34|1Co.7:34]] τὰ περί ὑμῶν, [[Php.2.20|Php.2:20]] before ὑπέρ, [[1Co.12.25|1Co.12:25]] with genitive (a construction otherwise unknown), ἑαυτῆς (WH; τὰ ἑ. Rec.; see Bl., § 35, 7), [[Mat.6.34|Mat.6:34]] (cf. προ-μεριμνάω).†
(AS)

G3366.def:
**μηδέ **
negative particle, related to οὐδέ as μή to οὐ,
1. as conic., **continuing a negation or prohibition, but not, and not, nor**: preceded by μή, [[Mat.6.25; 22.29|Mat.6:25 22:29]], [[Mrk.12.24|Mrk.12:24]], [[Luk.14.12|Luk.14:12]], al.; ἵνα μή, [[Jhn.4.15|Jhn.4:15]] ὅπως μή, [[Luk.16.26|Luk.16:26]] μηδέ . . . μηδέ, neither . . . nor, [[Mat.10.10|Mat.10:10]], [[1Co.10.8-9|1Co.10:8-9]].
2. As adv., **strengthening a negation, not even**: [[Mrk.2.2|Mrk.2:2]], [[1Co.5.11|1Co.5:11]], al
(AS)

G3358.def:
**μέτρον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for מִדָּה, also for אֵיפָה, etc. ;]
1. **that which is used for measuring, a measure**;
(a) **a vessel**: fig., [[Mat.23.32|Mat.23:32]], [[Luk.6.38|Luk.6:38]]; ἐκ μ., by measure, [[Jhn.3.34|Jhn.3:34]]
(b) **a rod or rule**: [[Rev.21.15, 17|Rev.21:15, 17]]; figuratively, [[Mat.7.2|Mat.7:2]], [[Mrk.4.24|Mrk.4:24]].
2. **That which is measured, measure**: with genitive of thing(s), [[Rom.12.3|Rom.12:3]], [[2Co.10.13|2Co.10:13]], [[Eph.4.7, 13; 4.16|Eph.4:7, 13 4:16]].†
(AS)

G3354.def:
**μετρέω**, -ῶ
(μέτρον), [in LXX: [[Exo.16.18|Exo.16:18]], [[Num.35.5|Num.35:5]], [[Rut.3.15|Rut.3:15]], [[Isa.40.12|Isa.40:12]], (מָדַד), Da Th [[Dan.5.26|Dan.5:26]] (מָדַד), [[Wis.4.8|Wis.4:8]] * ;]
1. to measure, of space, number, value, etc.: with accusative of thing(s), [[Rev.11.2; 21.15, 17|Rev.11:2 21:15, 17]]; with dative instr., [[Rev.11.1; 21.16|Rev.11:1 21:16]]. Metaphorical, ἑαυτὸν ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[2Co.10.12|2Co.10:12]]
2. **to measure out, give by measure**: prov., ἐν ὧ μέτρῳ κ.τ.λ., [[Mat.7.2|Mat.7:2]], [[Mrk.4.24|Mrk.4:24]], [[Luk.6.38|Luk.6:38]] (WH, mg., cf. ἀντι-μετρέω).†
(AS)

G3385.def:
**μή-τι **
interrog. particle, **expecting a negative answer**: [[Mat.7.16; 26.22, 25|Mat.7:16 26:22, 25]], [[Mrk.4.21; 14.19|Mrk.4:21 14:19]], [[Luk.6.39|Luk.6:39]], [[Jhn.8.22; 18.35|Jhn.8:22 18:35]], [[Act.10.47|Act.10:47]], [[2Co.12.18|2Co.12:18]], [[Jas.3.11|Jas.3:11]]; in hesitant questions (see M, _Pr._, 170.), μ οὗτός ἐστιν,
can this be, [[Mat.12.23|Mat.12:23]], [[Jhn.4.29|Jhn.4:29]]; μ. ἄρα, [[2Co.1.17|2Co.1:17]] On εἰ μήτι ([[Luk.9.13|Luk.9:13]], cf. Bl., § 65, 6), see: εἰ.†
**εἰ**,
_conjunctive particle_, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
I. Conditional, **if**;
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption;
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[Mat.11.14|Mat.11:14]], [[Rom.8.25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[Mrk.4.23; 9.22|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[Jhn.15.18|Jhn.15:18]], [[1Co.7.9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[Luk.16.31|Luk.16:31]], [[Rom.8.11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[Mat.12.26|Mat.12:26]], [[Rom.4.14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[Luk.17.6|Luk.17:6]], [[Jhn.8.39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[Mat.6.23|Mat.6:23]], [[Jhn.5.47; 7.23; 8.46|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[1Pe.2.20|1Pe.2:20]];
(b) fut.: [[Mat.26.33|Mat.26:33]], [[1Pe.2.20|1Pe.2:20]];
(with) pf.: [[Jhn.11.12|Jhn.11:12]], [[Rom.6.5|Rom.6:5]], al.;
(d) aor.: [[Luk.16.11; 19.8|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[Jhn.13.32; 18.23|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[Rev.20.15|Rev.20:15]], al.
2. **Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί**: [[Mat.12.28|Mat.12:28]], [[Jhn.7.4|Jhn.7:4]], [[Rom.5.17|Rom.5:17]], al.
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[Mrk.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1Jn.3.13|1Jn.3:13]], al.
5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[Num.14.3|Num.14:3]]o, [[1Sa.14.45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[Mrk.8.12|Mrk.8:12]], [[Heb.3.11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, **to express a merely possible condition**: [[Act.24.19; 27.39|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[1Co.14.10; 15.37|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17.
II. Interrogative, **if, whether**.
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[Mat.26.63|Mat.26:63]], [[Mrk.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[Act.19.2|Act.19:2]], [[2Co.13.5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[Mrk.3.2|Mrk.3:2]], [[Act.8.22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[Mrk.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1Co.1.16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, _Pr._, 194), [[Php.3.12|Php.3:12]]
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[Gen.17.17|Gen.17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), **in direct questions**: [[Mrk.8.23|Mrk.8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[Luk.13.23; 22.49|Luk.13:23, 22:49]], [[Act.19.2|Act.19:2]], al.
III. With other particles.
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
2. εἰ δὲ καί, **but if also**: [[Luk.11.18|Luk.11:18]] **but even if**, [[1Co.4.7|1Co.4:7]], [[2Co.4.3; 11.16|2Co.4:3 11:16]].
3. εἰ δὲ μή, **but if not, but if otherwise**: [[Mrk.2.21, 22|Mrk.2:21, 22]] [[Jhn.14.2|Jhn.14:2]], [[Rev.2.5|Rev.2:5]], al.
4. εἰ καί, **if even, if also, although**: [[Mrk.14.29|Mrk.14:29]], [[Luk.11.8|Luk.11:8]], [[1Co.7.21|1Co.7:21]], [[2Co.4.16|2Co.4:16]], [[Php.2.17|Php.2:17]], al.
5. καὶ εἰ, **even if**, see: καί
6. εἰ μή, **if not, unless, except, but only**: [[Mat.24.22|Mat.24:22]], [[Mrk.2.26; 6.5|Mrk.2:26 6:5]], [[Jhn.9.33|Jhn.9:33]], [[1Co.7.17|1Co.7:17]] (**only**), [[Gal.1.19|Gal.1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., _Ja._, xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[1Co.14.5; 15.2|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[1Ti.5.19|1Ti.5:19]].
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, _Pr._, 46), in oaths, **surely** ([[Ezk.33.27|Eze.33:27]], al.): [[Heb.6.14|Heb.6:14]].
8. εἴ πως, **if haply**: [[Act.27.12|Act.27:12]], [[Rom.1.10|Rom.1:10]].
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, **whether . . . or**; [[Rom.12.6-8|Rom.12:6-8]], [[1Co.3.22; 13.8|1Co.3:22 13:8]], al.
(AS)

G3367.def:
**μηδείς**, -δεμία, -δέν
(and -θέν, [[Act.27.33|Act.27:33]], a Hellenistic form; see Bl., 6, 7; Thackeray, _Gr._, 58)
related to οὐδείς as μή to οὐ,
**no, none, no one**; neut., **nothing**: [[Mat.16.20|Mat.16:20]], [[Mrk.5.43; 6.8|Mrk.5:43 6:8]], [[Luk.3.14|Luk.3:14]], [[Act.8.24|Act.8:24]], [[Rom.13.8|Rom.13:8]], al.; with genitive, [[Act.4.17; 24.23|Act.4:17 24:23]]; neut. accusative, μηδέν, adverbially, in no respect, [[Act.10.20; 11.12|Act.10:20 11:12]]; as accusative obj. after verb, βλάπτειν, [[Luk.4.35|Luk.4:35]] ὠφελεῖσθαι, [[Mrk.5.26|Mrk.5:26]] ὑστερεῖν, [[2Co.11.5|2Co.11:5]] μεριμνᾶν, [[Php.4.6|Php.4:6]] in double negation, strengthening the denial, μηκέτι μ., [[Mrk.11.14|Mrk.11:14]], [[Act.4.17|Act.4:17]]; μὴ . . . μηδέν (μηδένα, μηδεμίαν), [[2Co.13.7|2Co.13:7]], [[2Th.2.3|2Th.2:3]], [[1Pe.3.6|1Pe.3:6]]
μηθείς, see. μηδείς
(AS)

G3327.def:
**μετα-βαίνω **
[in LXX: [[Wis.7.27; 19.19|Wis.7:27 19:19]], [[2Ma.6.1|2Ma.6:1]] [[2Mac.6.9|2Mac 6:9]] [[2Mac.6.24|2Mac 6:24]] * ;]
**to pass over from one place to another **: [[Mat.17.20|Mat.17:20]], [[Luk.10.7|Luk.10:7]]; with reference to the point of departure only, **to withdraw, depart**: [[Mat.8.34; 11.1; 12.9; 15.29|Mat.8:34 11:1 12:9 15:29]], [[Jhn.7.3|Jhn.7:3]], [[Act.18.7|Act.18:7]]; of removal from this life, ἐκ τ. κότμου πρὸς τ. Πατέρα, [[Jhn.13.1|Jhn.13:1]] metaphorically, ἐκ τ. θανάτου εἰς τ. ζωήν, [[Jhn.5.24|Jhn.5:24]], [[1Jn.3.14|1Jn.3:14]].†
(AS)

G3306.def:
**μένω**,
[in LXX for קוּם ,עמד, etc. ;]
**to stay, abide, remain**.
1. Intrans.;
(i) **of place**: before ἐν, [[Luk.8.27|Luk.8:27]], al.; παρά, with dative of person(s), [[Jhn.1.40|Jhn.1:40]], al; σύν, [[Luk.1.56|Luk.1:56]] καθ᾽ ἑαυτόν, [[Act.28.16|Act.28:16]] with adv., ἐκεῖ, [[Mat.10.11|Mat.10:11]] ὧδε, [[Mat.26.38|Mat.26:38]] metaphorically, [[1Jn.2.18|1Jn.2:18]] of the Holy Spirit, [[Jhn.1.32, 33; 14.17|Jhn.1:32, 33 14:17]]; of Christ, [[Jhn.6.56; 15.4|Jhn.6:56 15:4]], al.; ὁ θεός, [[1Jn.4.15|1Jn.4:15]], conversely, of Christians, [[Jhn.6.56; 15.4|Jhn.6:56 15:4]], [[1Jn.4.15|1Jn.4:15]], al.; ὁ λόγος τ. θεοῦ, [[1Jn.2.14|1Jn.2:14]] ἡ ἀλήθεια, [[2Jn.2|II Jo 2]], al.
(ii) **Of time**;
(a) **of persons**: [[Php.1.25|Php.1:25]] before εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, [[Jhn.12.34|Jhn.12:34]], [[Heb.7.24|Heb.7:24]], [[1Jn.2.17|1Jn.2:17]]; ὀλίγον, [[Rev.17.10|Rev.17:10]] ἕως ἔρχομαι, [[Jhn.21.22, 23|Jhn.21:22, 23]];
(b) **of things, lasting or enduring**: cities, [[Mat.11.23|Mat.11:23]], [[Heb.13.14|Heb.13:14]]; λόγος θεοῦ, [[1Pe.1.23|1Pe.1:23]] ἁμαρτία, [[Jhn.9.41|Jhn.9:41]]
(iii) **Of condition**: with pred., μόνος, [[Jhn.12.24|Jhn.12:24]] ἄγαμος, [[1Co.7.11|1Co.7:11]] πιστός, [[2Ti.2.13|2Ti.2:13]] ἱερεύς, [[Heb.7.3|Heb.7:3]] with adv., οὕτως, [[1Co.7.40|1Co.7:40]] ὡς κἀγώ, ib. 8; before ἐν, ib. 20, 24.
2. Trans. (Bl., §34, 1; Field, _Notes_, 132): with accusative of person(s), [[Act.20.5, 23|Act.20:5, 23]] (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, περι-, προσ-, ὑπο-μένω).
(AS)

G3319.def:
**μέσος**, -η, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for תָּוֶךְ ;]
**middle, in the middle or midst**;
1. prop., as an adj.: [[Luk.23.45|Luk.23:45]], [[Jhn.19.18|Jhn.19:18]], [[Act.1.18|Act.1:18]]; with genitive pl., [[Luk.22.55|Luk.22:55]], [[Jhn.1.26|Jhn.1:26]]; genitive temp. (Bl., § 36, 13), μέσης νυκτός, [[Mat.25.6|Mat.25:6]] μ. ἡμέρας, [[Act.26.13|Act.26:13]]
2. In adverbial phrases, neut., μέσον, τὸ μ., as subst.: ἀνὰ μέσον, with genitive, between (cl.; in LXX: [[Gen.1.4|Gen.1:4]], al.), elliptically (but see M, _Pr._, 99), [[1Co.6.5|1Co.6:5]] = ἐν μ., among, in the midst of (El., § 39, 2; 40, 8; cf. in LXX: [[Jos.19.1|Jos.19:1]], [[Sir.27.2|Sir.27:2]]), [[Mat.13.25|Mat.13:25]], [[Mrk.7.31|Mrk.7:31]], [[Rev.7.17|Rev.7:17]]; διὰ μέσου, with genitive, [[Luk.4.30|Luk.4:30]] διὰ μέσον (Rec. -ου, see 81., § 42, 1), between, [[Luk.17.11|Luk.17:11]] (_ICC_, in l); εἰς τὸ μ. (see: εἰς), [[Mrk.3.3|Mrk.3:3]], [[Luk.4.35; 5.19; 6.8|Luk.4:35 5:19 6:8]], [[Jhn.20.19, 26|Jhn.20:19, 26]]; εἰς μ., [[Mrk.14.60|Mrk.14:60]] ἐν τῷ μ., [[Mat.14.6|Mat.14:6]] ἐν μ., [[Jos.8.3|Jos.8:3]], 9, [[Act.4.7|Act.4:7]]; with, genitive loc., [[Mrk.6.47|Mrk.6:47]], [[Luk.21.21; 22.55|Luk.21:21 22:55]], [[Act.17.22|Act.17:22]], [[Heb.2.12|Heb.2:12]]" (LXX), [[Rev.4.6; 5.6; 22.2|Rev.4:6 5:6 22:2]]. with genitive pl., [[Mat.10.16; 18.2, 20|Mat.10:16 18:2, 20]], [[Mrk.9.36|Mrk.9:36]], [[Luk.2.46; 8.7; 10.3; 22.27; 24.36|Luk.2:46 8:7 10:3 22:27 24:36]], [[Act.1.15; 2.22; 27.21|Act.1:15 2:22 27:21]], [[1Th.2.7|1Th.2:7]], [[Rev.1.13; 2.1; 5.6; 6.6|Rev.1:13 2:1 5:6 6:6]]; κατὰ μέσον τ. νυκτός, [[Act.27.27|Act.27:27]] (Bl., § 47, 6); ἐκ τοῦ μ. (Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 252 f.), [[Col.2.14|Col.2:14]] ἐκ μ.., [[2Th.2.7|2Th.2:7]] ἐκ τοῦ μ., with genitive, [[Mat.13.49|Mat.13:49]], [[Act.17.33; 23.10|Act.17:33 23:10]], [[1Co.5.2|1Co.5:2]], [[2Co.6.17|2Co.6:17]].
3. Neut., μέσον, adverbially, with genitive, in the midst of, [[Mat.14.24|Mat.14:24]] (WH, txt., R, mg., aliter), [[Php.2.15|Php.2:15]] (διὰ μέσου­see supr.-also [[Jhn.8.50|Jhn.8:50]], R, mg.).†
(AS)

G3360.def:
**μέχρι**
(bef. consonants, exc. [[Luk.16.16|Luk.16:16]], μέχρι Ἰωάνου) and μέχρις (bef. vowels, Mk, Ga, ll. with, [[Heb.12.4|Heb.12:4]] see Bl., § 5, 4)
1. as prep., with genitive, as far as, even to, until;
(a) **of place**: [[Rom.15.19|Rom.15:19]]
(b) **of time **: [[Mat.11.23; 13.30; 28.15|Mat.11:23 13:30 28:15]], [[Luk.16.16|Luk.16:16]], [[Act.10.30; 20.7|Act.10:30 20:7]], [[Rom.5.14|Rom.5:14]], [[1Ti.6.14|1Ti.6:14]], [[Heb.3.6, 14; 9.10|Heb.3:6, 14 9:10]];
(with) **of measure or degree **: [[Php.2.8, 30|Php.2:8, 30]], [[2Ti.2.9|2Ti.2:9]], [[Heb.12.4|Heb.12:4]] (μ. αἵματος, cf. [[2Ma.13.14|2Ma.13:14]]).
2. As conjunct. (as long as), **until**: [[Eph.4.13|Eph.4:13]] μ. οὗ (Thuc., iii, 28, but more frequently μ. ἄν see BI., § 65, 10), [[Mrk.13.30|Mrk.13:30]], [[Gal.4.19|Gal.4:19]] (μ. is prop, an adv., cf. Lat. usgue, before prep. or adv.; LS, see word, and cf. ἄχρι).†
(AS)

G3339.def:
**μετα-μορφόω**, -ῶ
[in Sm.: [[Psa.34.1|Psa.34:1]] * ;]
**to transform, trans­figure**: pass., of Christ's transfiguration, [[Mat.17.2|Mat.17:2]], [[Mrk.9.2|Mrk.9:2]] (cf. [[Luk.9.29|Luk.9:29]]); of Christians, [[Rom.12.2|Rom.12:2]], [[2Co.3.18|2Co.3:18]].†
_SYN._: μετασχηματίζω, to change in fashion or appearance, see: μορφή, and cf. Lft., Phi., 125 ff (AS)

G3342.def:
**μεταξύ**
(μετά + ξύν = σύν), [in LXX: [[Gen.31.50|Gen.31:50]], [[Jdg.5.27|Jdg.5:27]], [[3Ki.15.6|III Ki 15:6]]; [[1Ki.15.32|3Ki.15:32]], [[Wis.4.10; 16.19; 18.23|Wis.4:10 16:19 18:23]] * ;]
1. adv. of place and time (in NT time only);
(a) **between**: ἐν τῷ μ. (s.with χρόνῳ), [[Jhn.4.31|Jhn.4:31]]
(b) in late writers (FlJ, Plut., al.), like μετά (adv.), **after, afterwards**: τὸ μ. σάββατον, [[Act.13.42|Act.13:42]] (cf. Cl., Ro., I Co., 44, 2).
2. Prep. with genitive, **between**: of place, [[Mat.23.35|Mat.23:35]], [[Luk.11.51; 16.26|Luk.11:51 16:26]], [[Act.12.6|Act.12:6]]; of persons, as to mutual relation, [[Mat.18.15|Mat.18:15]], [[Act.15.9|Act.15:9]], [[Rom.2.1-29; 15.1-33|Rom.2:1-29 15:1-33]].†
(AS)

G3338.def:
**μετα-μέλομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for נָהַם: ni. ;]
depon., pass.,
**to regret, repent one**: [[Mat.21.30, 32; 27.3|Mat.21:30, 32 27:3]], [[2Co.7.8|2Co.7:8]], [[Heb.7.21|Heb.7:21]]" (LXX) †
_SYN._: μετανοέω, to change one's mind, repent. On the distinc­tion, difficult to maintain by usage, between these words, see Thayer, see word; Tr., _Syn._, § lxix (AS)

G3396.def:
**μίγνυμι**
(on the spelling μείγ-, ν. B)., § 3, 5) [in LXX for עָרַב hith., etc. ;]
**to mix, mingle**: with accusative and dative, [[Rev.15.2|Rev.15:2]] with accusative before ἐν, [[Rev.8.7|Rev.8:7]] before μετά, [[Mat.27.34|Mat.27:34]], [[Luk.13.1|Luk.13:1]].†
_SYN._: κεράννυμι, q.v (AS)

G3373.def:
**μηκύνω**
(μῆκος), [in LXX: [[Isa.44.14|Isa.44:14]] (גָּדַל pi.), [[Ezk.12.25, 28|Eze.12:25, 28]] (מָשַׁךְ ni.) * ;]
**to lengthen, extend**: of causing plants to grow, Isa, l.with; pass. (mid., Swete, in l), **to grow**: [[Mrk.4.27|Mrk.4:27]]†
(AS)

G3317.def:
**μεσο-νύκτιος** (on seel, μεσα-, see Bl., § 6, 2), -ον
(μέσος, νύξ), [in LXX chiefly for לַיִל חֵצִי ;]
**of or at midnight**; as subst., neut., τὸ μ., midnight (Arist. and late writers) : genitive, [[Luk.11.5|Luk.11:5]] μέχρι μ., [[Act.20.7|Act.20:7]] κατὰ τὸ μ., [[Act.16.25|Act.16:25]] accusative (Rec., genitive; see Bl., § 34, 8), [[Mrk.13.35|Mrk.13:35]]†
μεσανύκτιον, see. μεσονύκτιος
(AS)

G3388.def:
**μήτρα**, -ας, ἡ
(μήτμρ), [in LXX chiefly for רֶחֶם ;]
**the womb**: [[Luk.2.23|Luk.2:23]] (LXX), [[Rom.4.19|Rom.4:19]]†
(AS)

G3330.def:
**μετα-δίδωμι **
[in LXX: [[Pro.11.29|Pro.11:29]] (שָׁבַר hi.), [[Wis.7.13|Wis.7:13]], al. ;]
**to give a share of, impart**: with dative of person(s) and accusative of thing(s) (in cl. more freq., with genitive part., but accusative of that which is imparted, whether part or whole, so here, see Bl., § 36, 1), [[Rom.1.11|Rom.1:11]], [[1Th.2.8|1Th.2:8]], and (with ellipse of accusative) [[Luk.3.11|Luk.3:11]] with dative of person(s), [[Eph.4.28|Eph.4:28]] absol., ὁ μεταδιδούς, [[Rom.12.8|Rom.12:8]]†
(AS)

G3353.def:
**μέτοχος**, -ον
(μετέχω), [in LXX chiefly for חָבֵר ;]
1. **sharing in, partaking of**: with genitive of thing(s), [[Heb.3.1; 6.4; 12.8|Heb.3:1 6:4 12:8]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[Heb.3.14|Heb.3:14]]
2. As subst., ὁ μ., **a partner, associate**: [[Luk.5.7|Luk.5:7]], [[Heb.1.9|Heb.1:9]]" (LXX)
(AS)

G3310.def:
**μερίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly חֵלֶק, חֶלְקָה ;]
1. (as in cl.) a part, **portion**: [[Luk.10.42|Luk.10:42]], [[Act.8.21|Act.8:21]], [[2Co.6.15|2Co.6:15]], [[Col.1.12|Col.1:12]].
2. In later Gk (see MM, xvi), **as geographical term, a division, district**: [[Act.16.12|Act.16:12]]†
(AS)

G3349.def:
**μετ-εωρίζω**
(μετέωρος, (a) in mid air; (b) buoyed up; (with) in suspense; Thuc.; in π. opposite to ἀμέριμνος, see Zorell, see word) [in LXX: Ob 4 (גָּבַהּ hi.), [[Mic.4.1|Mic.4:1]] (נָשָׂא ni.), [[Psa.131.1|Psa.131:1]], [[Ezk.10.16-17, 19|Eze.10:16-17, 19]] (רוּם), [[2Ma.5.17|2Ma.5:17]] [[2Mac.7.34|2Mac 7:34]], [[3Ma.6.5|3Ma.6:5]] * ;]
to raise on high (Thue., Xen., al.; Ob, Mi, Ez, ll with). Metaphorical,
(a) **to buoy up**; pass., to be elated, puffed up (Polyb., al., [[Psa.2.1-12|Psa.2:1-12]], 3 Mac, ll. with)
(b) to be anxious, in suspense (Polyb., see 70, 10; FlJ, BJ, iv, 2, 5) : [[Luk.12.29|Luk.12:29]]†
(AS)

G3377.def:
**μηνύω **
[in LXX: [[2Ma.3.7|2Ma.3:7]] [[2Mac.6.11|2Mac 6:11]] [[2Mac.14.37|2Mac 14:37]], [[3Ma.3.28|3Ma.3:28]], [[4Ma.4.3|4Ma.4:3]] * ;]
**to disclose, declare, make known**: [[Luk.20.37|Luk.20:37]], [[1Co.10.28|1Co.10:28]]; in forensic sense, **to inform, report**: [[Jhn.11.57|Jhn.11:57]] pass., with dative of person(s), [[Act.23.30|Act.23:30]]†
(AS)

G3323.def:
**Μεσσίας**, -ου, ὁ (Aram. מְשִׁיחָא = _Heb._ מָשִׁיחַ = Χριστός, which see),
**Messiah**: [[Jhn.1.42; 4.22|Jhn.1:42 4:22]].†
(AS)

G3355.def:
**μετρητής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(μετρέω), [in LXX: [[1Ki.18.32|3Ki.18:32]] (סְאָה), [[2Ch.4.5|2Ch.4:5]], (בַּת), etc. ;]
1. a measurer (Plat.).
2. = ἀμφορεύς, an Attic measure, = 11⁄2 Roman amphoræ or about 9 Eng. gallons: [[Jhn.2.6|Jhn.2:6]]†
(AS)

G3305.def:
**μέν-τοι**
= μέν τοι,
**yet, however**: [[Jhn.4.27|Jhn.4:27]], al.; εἰ μ., [[Jas.2.8|Jas.2:8]] (if indeed).
(AS)

G3322.def:
**μεσόω**, -ῶ
(μέσός), [in LXX: μεσούσης τ. νυκός, [[Exo.12.29|Exo.12:29]] (חֵצִי), etc. ;]
to be in the middle, esp. of time: τ. ἑορτῆς μεσούσης, in the middle of the feast, [[Jhn.7.14|Jhn.7:14]]†
(AS)

G3395.def:
**μίγμα** (LT, cl., μῖγμα; on the orthogr., see B1., § 3, 5), -τος, τό
(μίγνυμι), [in LXX: [[Sir.38.8|Sir.38:8]] * ;]
**a mixture**: [[Jhn.19.39|Jhn.19:39]] (ἕλιγμα, WH, R, mg.).†
(AS)

G3325.def:
**μεστόω**, -ῶ
(μεστός), [in LXX: [[3Ma.5.1|3Ma.5:1]] [[3Mac.5.10|3Mac 5:10]] * ;]
**to fill**: pass., with genitive of thing(s), [[Act.2.13|Act.2:13]]†
(AS)

G3344.def:
**μετα στρέφω **
[in LXX chiefly for הָפַךְ ;]
**to turn about, turn, change**: pass., [[Act.2.20|Act.2:20]] (LXX), [[Jas.4.9|Jas.4:9]] (WH, txt., μετατρέπω, which see); in evil sense, to pervert, corrupt (cf. primary sense reverse) : [[Gal.1.7|Gal.1:7]]†
μετα-τρέπω
[in LXX: [[4Ma.6.5|4Ma.6:5]] [[4Mac.7.3|4Mac 7:3]] [[4Mac.7.12|4Mac 7:12]] [[4Mac.15.11|4Mac 15:11]] [[4Mac.15.18|4Mac 15:18]] * ;]
to turn about, turn (Hom., al., but not found in Att..) : with accusative, [[Jas.4.9|Jas.4:9]] (WH, txt.; cf. μεταστρέφω).†
(AS)

G3335.def:
**μετα-λαμξάνω **
[in LXX: [[Est.5.1|Est.5:1]], [[Wis.18.9|Wis.18:9]] [[4Ma.12.1-19|4Ma.12:1-19]] * ;]
**to have or get a share of, partake of**: with genitive of thing(s), [[2Ti.2.6|2Ti.2:6]], [[Heb.6.7; 12.10|Heb.6:7 12:10]]; τροφῆς, [[Act.2.46; 27.33-34|Act.2:46 27:33-34]]; with accusative of thing(s) (of the whole), **to get**: καιρόν, [[Act.24.25|Act.24:25]] (see Bl., § 36, 1; MM, xvi).†
(AS)

G3351.def:
**μετ-οικίζω**
(μέτοικος, an emigrant), [in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה hi. ;]
**to remove to a new abode, cause to migrate**: [[Act.7.4, 43|Act.7:4, 43]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G3333.def:
**μετα-καλέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Hos.11.1-2|Hos.11:1-2]] (קָרָא), I [[Est.1.50|Est.1:50]] * ;]
to call from one place to another. Mid., **to send for**: with accusative, [[Act.7.14; 10.32; 20.17; 24.25|Act.7:14 10:32 20:17 24:25]].†
(AS)

G3346.def:
**μετα-τίθημι **
[in LXX: [[Gen.5.24|Gen.5:24]] (לָקַח), [[Deu.27.17|Deu.27:17]], al. (סוּג hi.), [[Sir.44.16|Sir.44:16]], [[2Ma.7.24|2Ma.7:24]], al ;]
1. **to transfer to another place**: with accusative, pass., [[Heb.11.5|Heb.11:5]] (LXX); before εἰς, [[Act.7.16|Act.7:16]]
2. **to change**: with accusative, pass., [[Heb.7.12|Heb.7:12]] before εἰς, figuratively, i.e. to make one thing a pretext for another, χάριν εἰς ἀσέλγειαν, [[Jude.4|Ju 4]]. Mid., **to change oneself, pass over**: before ἀπό and εἰς, [[Gal.1.6|Gal.1:6]] (cf. 2Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G3314.def:
**μεσημβρία**, -ας, ἡ
(μέσος, ἡμέρα), [in LXX chiefly for צֹהַר, [[Gen.3.16|Gen.3:16]], al; also for נֶגֶב, Dan LXX 8:4, 9, al. ;]
1. **noon**: [[Act.22.6|Act.22:6]]
2. **the South**: [[Act.8.26|Act.8:26]]†
(AS)

G3365.def:
**μηδαμῶς**
(= μηδαμῆ, -δαμά, adv. fr. μηδαμός = μηδείς) [in LXX chiefly for הָלִלָה, הָלילָה ;]
by no means, not at all. μ., Κύριε (sc. τοῦτο γένοιτο), [[Act.10.14; 11.8|Act.10:14 11:8]].†
(AS)

G3357.def:
**μετρίως **
_adv._ (μέτριος, moderate), [in LXX: [[2Ma.15.1-39|2Ma.15:1-39]] * ;]
**moderately**: litotes, οὐ μ., exceedingly, [[Act.20.12|Act.20:12]]†
(AS)

G3399.def:
**Μίλητος**, -ου, ἡ, Miletus
**a maritime city of Caria **: [[Act.20.15, 17|Act.20:15, 17]], [[2Ti.4.20|2Ti.4:20]].†
(AS)

G3328.def:
**μετα-βάλλω **
[in LXX chiefly for הָפַךְ ;]
to turn about, change. Pass. and mid., to turn oneself about; metaphorically, **to change one's mind**: [[Act.28.6|Act.28:6]]†
(AS)

G3337.def:
**μετ-αλλάσσω **
[in LXX: [[Est.2.7|Est.2:7]] (מוּת), [[Est.2.20|Est.2:20]], [[1Es.1.31|1Es.1:31]] [[Est.1.2|Est.1:2]] Mac.9 * ;]
1. **to exchange**: τ. ἀλήθειαν . . . ἐν τ. ψεύδει, the truth for a lie (see Bl., § 36, 8), Rom_1:25.
2. **to change**: with accusative before εἰς, Rom_1:26 (ἀλλάσσω).†
(AS)

G3345.def:
**μετα-σχηματίζω **
[in LXX: [[4Ma.9.22|4Ma.9:22]] * ;]
**to change in fashion or appearance**: with accusative of thing(s), τ. σῶμα, [[Php.3.21|Php.3:21]] mid., before εἰς, [[2Co.11.13-14;|2Co.11:13-14]] before ὡς, [[2Co.11.15|2Co.11:15]] of a rhetorical device, to transfer by a fiction (Field, _Notes_, in l), before εἰς, [[1Co.4.6|1Co.4:6]]†
_SYN._: μεταμορφόω, q.v (AS)

G3348.def:
**μετ-έχω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.5.17|Pro.5:17]] (עֵת), [[Pro.1.18|Pro.1:18]], [[1Es.5.40|1Es.5:40]] [[Est.8.70|Est.8:70]], [[Sir.51.28|Sir.51:28]], al. ;]
**to partake of, share in**: ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι τοῦ μετέχειν, [[1Co.9.10|1Co.9:10]] with genitive of thing(s), [[1Co.9.12; 10.21; 10.30|1Co.9:12 10:21 10:30]], [[Heb.2.14|Heb.2:14]]; in sacramental sense, ἑκ τ. ἐνὸς ἄρτου μ., [[1Co.10.17|1Co.10:17]] (cf. MM, xvi); metaphorically, γάλακτος, [[Heb.5.13|Heb.5:13]] of belonging to a tribe, [[Heb.7.13|Heb.7:13]]†
(AS)

G3352.def:
**μετοχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(μετέχω), [in LXX: [[Psa.122.3|Psa.122:3]] א R (חָבַר pu.) * ;]
**sharing, fellowship**: [[2Co.6.14|2Co.6:14]]†
(AS)

G3316.def:
**μεσίτης**, -ου, ὁ
(μέσος), [in LXX: [[Job.9.33|Job.9:33]] (בֵּין)* ;]
**an arbitrator, mediator**: [[Gal.3.19|Gal.3:19]] with dupl. genitive of person(s), θεοῦ κ. ἀνθρώπων, [[1Ti.2.5|1Ti.2:5]] with genitive of thing(s), διαθήκης, [[Heb.8.6; 9.15; 12.24|Heb.8:6 9:15 12:24]]; ὁ δε μ. ἑνὸς οὐκ ἔστιν, [[Gal.3.20|Gal.3:20]] (see Lft., in l; and for exx. of this word in π., see MM, xvi).†
(AS)

G3320.def:
**μεσότοιχον**, -ου, τό
(μέσος, τοῖχος)
**a partition wall**: [[Eph.2.14|Eph.2:14]] (not elsewhere, but see LS, see word μεσότοιχος).†
(AS)

G3334.def:
**μετα-κινέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Deu.19.14|Deu.19:14]] (סוּג hi.), [[Isa.54.10|Isa.54:10]] (מוֹט), etc. ;]
trans.,
to move away, remove (ὅρια, Deu, l.with). Mid., **to remove oneself, remove, shift**: metaphorically, ἀπὸ τ. ἐλπίδος, [[Col.1.23|Col.1:23]]†
(AS)

G3389.def:
**μητρολῴας** (Rec. -αλῴας, in cl., -αλοίας, see B1., § 3, 3; 6, 2), -ου, ὁ
(μήτρρ + ἀλοιάω, to smite)
(a) **a matricide**: [[1Ti.1.9|1Ti.1:9]] (AV, R, txt., but see infr.);
(b) **a smiter of his mother**: [[1Ti.1.9|1Ti.1:9]] (R, mg., cf. [[Exo.21.15|Exo.21:15]], and see Ellic., CGT, in l).†
(AS)

G3311.def:
**μερισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(μερίζω), [in LXX for מַחְלְקָה, מַחֲלֹקֶת, [[Jos.11.23|Jos.11:23]], [[Est.6.18|Est.6:18]] * ;]
1. **a dividing, division**: ψυχῆς κ. πνεύματος (i.e. between them or of the things themselves, see Westc., in l), [[Heb.4.12|Heb.4:12]]
2. **a dis­tribution, bestowal **(cf. μερίζω, 2); pl., [[Heb.2.4|Heb.2:4]]†
(AS)

G3356.def:
**μετριοπαθέω**, -ῶ
(μετριοπαθής, moderating one's passions),
**to hold one's passions or emotions in restraint; hence, to bear gently with, feel gently towards**: [[Heb.5.2|Heb.5:2]]†
(AS)

G3375.def:
**μήν **
a particle of assurance, **verily**, **truly**; εἰ (εἶ) μ. (= cl., ἦ μ. in LXX and π.), **now verily, full surely**: [[Heb.6.14|Heb.6:14]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G3331.def:
**μετά-θεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(μετατίθημι) [in LXX: [[2Ma.11.24|2Ma.11:24]] * ;]
1. **change of position, removal **: [[Heb.11.5|Heb.11:5]]
2. **change, as of that which has been established **: [[Heb.7.12; 12.27|Heb.7:12 12:27]].†
(AS)

G3329.def:
**μετ-άγω **
[in LXX: [[3Ki.8.47-48|3Ki.8:47-48]], [[2Ch.6.37|2Ch.6:37]] (שָׁבָה) [[2Ch.36.3|2Ch.36:3]] (סוּר hi.), [[1Es.1.45|1Es.1:45]] [[Est.2.10|Est.2:10]] [[Est.5.69|Est.5:69]], [[Est.8.17|Est.8:17]], Sir prol.16 [[Sir.10.8|Sir.10:8]], [[2Ma.1.33|2Ma.1:33]] * ;]
1. in Xen., Plut., and later writers, to transfer, transport (so LXX).
2. In sense other­wise unknown (see Hort, in l), **to turn about, direct**: [[Jas.3.3-4|Jas.3:3-4]]†
(AS)

G3394.def:
**μιασμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(μιαίνω), [in LXX: [[Wis.14.26|Wis.14:26]], [[1Ma.4.43|1Ma.4:43]] * ;]
1. prop., the act of defiling.
2. = μίασμα (which see) : [[2Pe.2.10|2Pe.2:10]] (cf. Plut., Mor., 393c).†
(AS)

G3393.def:
**μίασμα**, -τος, τό
(μιαίνω),
chiefly in trag. and late writers;
[in LXX: [[Lev.7.8, 18|Lev.7:8, 18]], (פִּגּוּל), [[Jer.32.34|Jer.32:34]] (שִׁקּוּץ), [[Ezk.33.31|Eze.33:31]] (בֶּצַע), [[Jdt.9.2, 4; 13.16|Jdth.9:2, 4 13:16]], [[1Ma.13.50|1Ma.13:50]] * ;]
**a stain, defilement**: pl., [[2Pe.2.20|2Pe.2:20]]†
(AS)

G3321.def:
**μεσουράνημα**, -τος, τό
(μεσουρανέω, to be in mid-heaven, of the sun at the meridian),
**the zenith, mid-heaven**: [[Rev.8.13; 14.6; 19.17|Rev.8:13 14:6 19:17]].†
(AS)

G3382.def:
**μηρός**, -oῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for יָרֵךְ ;]
**the thigh**: [[Rev.19.16|Rev.19:16]]†
(AS)
